name: Computer World
summary: "Computer World" is a fun, unique, multiplayer game! You can buy cosmetics to make your character look just how you want it too! It also contains many game modes like, Hangout, Parkour, Robbery, and Low Gravity! We also use voice chat to connect with others. Explore fun secrets and collect all the collectable cosmetics! We Computer World developers hope you and your friends have a great time playing!
